parameters.query: SELECT t.id, t.code, t.sport, t.name, t.short_name, t.logo_key, t.area, t.city, DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS created_on, cap.name AS captain_name, cap.photo_key AS captain_photo_key, (SELECT m.role FROM team_members m WHERE m.team_id = t.id AND m.user_id = cap.id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE') AS manager_role, (SELECT m.role FROM team_members m WHERE m.team_id = t.id AND m.user_id = viewer.id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE') AS my_role, (SELECT m.status FROM team_members m WHERE m.team_id = t.id AND m.user_id = viewer.id) AS my_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members m WHERE m.team_id = t.id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role <> 'COACH') AS members, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', m.id, 'user_id', m.user_id, 'role', m.role, 'position', COALESCE(m.position, s.role),   'jersey_name', COALESCE(m.jersey_name, au.jersey_name), 'jersey_number', COALESCE(m.jersey_number, au.jersey_number),   'name', COALESCE(au.name, m.guest_name), 'photo_key', COALESCE(au.photo_key, m.guest_photo_key),   'age', TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, COALESCE(au.birthdate, m.guest_birthdate), CURDATE()),   'birthdate', DATE_FORMAT(m.guest_birthdate, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'gender', m.guest_gender, 'parent_phone', m.parent_phone,   'is_guest', m.user_id IS NULL, 'is_me', m.user_id = viewer.id))  FROM team_members m LEFT JOIN app_users au ON au.id = m.user_id  LEFT JOIN app_user_sports s ON s.user_id = m.user_id AND s.sport = t.sport  WHERE m.team_id = t.id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE') AS roster FROM teams t JOIN app_users cap ON cap.id = t.captain_user_id LEFT JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 WHERE t.code = $2
